question.text: Which of the following listed-entity categories is exempt under LODR from the mandatory dematerialised transfer requirement?

answer.text: None of the listed-entity categories shown — no such entity-level exemption is cited among the options

explanation.text: The Logic: No listed-entity category exemption is cited among the options. The mandatory demat transfer rule applies, while transaction/process exceptions remain for transmission, transposition, and eligible relodged pre-deadline transfer deeds. The Trap: SMEs, government companies, and small-shareholder companies are not carved out as entity-level exempt categories. Note: Exceptions are framed around specific transactions or processes (transmission, transposition, relodged pre-deadline transfer deeds), not entity categories.
